text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring). Super 
Creek is provoked by Tamamo Cross.

Furthermore, she took a provocative 
attitude toward the Trainer as well, 
saying, "I'll make sure you can't get back 
on your feet."

Determined not to let her Trainer be hurt, 
Super Creek fired up her spirit and headed 
off to face Tamamo Cross.
